title: Bank Deposit Volume Relief on Mobile Wallet Resend Charges
content:
Customers who also send through **Bank Deposit** receive a relief on **Mobile Wallet** resend charges, according to how much Bank Deposit principal Paloma has collected from them recently.

**Relief rule.** The Bank Deposit relief on a resend charge follows the principal of the customer's Bank Deposit payments collected in the last 6 calendar months, that is the amounts of their Bank Deposit funds-received entries in that window:

| Bank Deposit principal collected in the window (USD) | Relief on the resend charge |
|---|---|
| 3000.00 or more | 0.30 of the charge |
| at least 1000.00 and below 3000.00 | 0.15 of the charge |
| below 1000.00 | none |

**The window.** It is a rolling window that holds the entries whose entry date lies fewer than 6 whole calendar months before today. The whole calendar months from a date to today are the difference between the two calendar months, less one when today's day of the month is lower than that date's.

## Window boundary (hypothetical, today 2026-04-20)

| Bank Deposit entry date | Calendar-month difference | Today's day lower than the entry's day | Whole months | In the window |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2025-10-21 | 6 | yes (20 against 21) | 5 | yes |
| 2025-10-20 | 6 | no | 6 | no |
| 2025-11-05 | 5 | no | 5 | yes |

## Hypothetical totals
- Entries of 1800.00 and 1200.00 in the window: 3000.00, relief 0.30.
- One entry of 999.99 in the window: relief none.
- Entries of 700.00 and 300.00 in the window: 1000.00, relief 0.15.
